items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the interviewer mentions Butzi Miller in relation to Son Miller, but there is no evidence of a personal connection between the interviewee and Butzi Miller.

ctx.x: No, not, drive him down, this piano player.

Oh, drive him down. Well, then that's what we call Son Miller, drive him down, because he played some dirty blues and then also his brother, Butzi. Butzi? Yeah, Butzi Miller. Butzi Miller. Butzi Miller.
Is Son Miller still in New Orleans?
